question:
**Choose the most suitable option to replace the underlined part of the sentence. If the sentence is already correct, select 'No substitution required'.**

Each of the candidates __**have submitted their documents**__ for verification.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"has"** is the correct verb form that matches the singular subject "Each of the candidates." (है)

 
 
• **Example:** Each of the students has completed the assignment.
 
 
 
• The word **"documents"** refers to official papers or records. (दस्तावेज़)
 
 
• **Example:** Please ensure all your documents are submitted before the deadline.
 
 
 
• Hence, "has submitted their documents" is grammatically correct because "Each of the candidates" is a singular subject, and "has" aligns with it.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: had submitted their document** (दस्तावेज़ जमा कर चुके थे): Incorrect because "had submitted" implies past perfect tense, which requires a specific past context.

 
 
• **Example:** The candidates had submitted their documents before the deadline last week.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: No substitution required** (कोई प्रतिस्थापन आवश्यक नहीं): Incorrect because the verb "have" does not match the singular subject "Each of the candidates."
 
• **Option 4: is submitted their documents** (दस्तावेज़ जमा किए जा रहे हैं): Incorrect because "is submitted" is grammatically incorrect in this context.
 
 
• **Example:** The form is submitted electronically, not manually.
